How often does Mrs. Bernal cook meat at night?

Does Amelia always go to the discotheque?

items: Mr. Carreño supervises the company *_almost every month_*.

Our boss gives us a call *_three times a week_*.

items.q: How often does Mr. Bernal visit the Institutes?
How often _do_ the English teachers get together?
How often do you go to work?
Does our boss give us a call everyday?
Does the secretary make a mistake almost everytime?

blocks.text: Now change the sentences using adverbs of frequency.

items.q: A good student studies *_almost every night_*.
Victor practices basketball *_three times a week_*.
We have a physical check-up *_twice a year_*.
Lily goes to Europe *_once in a while_*.

blocks.text: *Situation:* Mr. Dodder and Dorothy are talking in the cafeteria after class.

rows: How often do you go to church?
I go to church once a week. And you?
I go there twice a week.
My sister Carla goes to church _three_ times a week. She usually prays every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
How often do you go to church?
I go there twice a week.
